# StudyMode

> > StudyMode provides student essays, study guides, and exam preparation resources for high school Advanced Placement courses and college-level academic assignments.

The platform features AP exam preparation materials aligned with College Board standards for subjects like Psychology and Biology, alongside student-contributed essays covering academic writing, nursing education (RN-to-BSN programs), business finance, and various college coursework topics.

## Key Topics

- Advanced Placement (AP) exam preparation
- College Board curriculum
- AP Psychology
- AP Biology
- APA format and academic writing
- Nursing education and RN-to-BSN programs
- High school curriculum resources
- College-level coursework
- Academic essays and assignments
- Exam study guides
- Literature review methodology
- Professional development in nursing
- Business and finance education
- Writing process and composition

## AP Exam Preparation

- [AP Psychology](https://www.studymode.com/ap-psychology/): AP Psychology exam prep with study materials and College Board resources
- [AP Biology](https://www.studymode.com/ap-biology): AP Biology test prep with notes, guides, and College Board materials

## Academic Writing and Composition

- [5 Steps of the Writing Process](https://www.studymode.com/essays/5-Steps-Of-The-Writing-Process-1880216.html): Student guide covering prewriting, drafting, and revising in COM/155
- [APA Format Module](https://www.studymode.com/essays/Apa-Format-Module-1615438.html): Student essay on APA format module for nursing RN-to-BSN coursework

## Business and Finance Essays

- [BFMS L02 Theory And Structure Of Interest Rates](https://www.studymode.com/essays/Bfms-L02-Theory-And-Structure-Of-75204025.html): IIMB banking finance essay on interest rates and Fisher Effect theory
- [Analysis of the General Environment Factors](https://www.studymode.com/essays/Analysis-Of-The-General-Environment-Factors-901907.html): Market analysis of diagnostic industry including Piramal and SRL Ranbaxy
